children: PROVIDES INFORMATION ON THE PLANNED RELOCATION OF OPERATIONS IN KLEINBASEL
THE PLANNED CESSATION OF PRODUCTION IN KLEINBASEL COULD LEAD TO THE LOSS OF AROUND 130 JOBS. ALL PLANNED CHANGES ARE SUBJECT TO THE INFORMATION AND CONSULTATION PROCESS
LABORATORIES SUPPORTING BIOLOGICAL CELL BANKS, ANALYTICAL TESTING AND TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENT ACTIVITIES ARE TO BE RELOCATED TO THE NOVARTIS CAMPUS IN BASEL BY THE END OF 2028
AS PART OF THIS TRANSITION, NOVARTIS INTENDS TO DISCONTINUE SMALL-SCALE PRODUCTION OF BIOLOGICS IN KLEINBASEL BY THE END OF 2027
PLANS ARE IN LINE WITH THE EXPIRY OF INDIVIDUAL LEASES AT THE KLEINBASEL SITE IN 2029
